title: VMF chosen targets
description: ADVISOR-1. The target a person chose for each machine, saved beside the reviewed assessment (target-choices.json) by Set-VmfTargetChoice. Bound to the assessment that was reviewed and to the target options the choice was made from. New-VmfPlan plans each machine on its choice; a machine with no choice is not moved. MACHINE-PICK-1: only a chosen machine may have a target, and TARGETS-NO-LIST-1 (v9): no target is saved before machine-choices.json.

schemaVersion.description: 9 (TARGETS-NO-LIST-1, 2026-11-12): machinesVersion and kernelDefault are required, and each choice names size, disks, method and kernel, null for none; New-VmfPlan reads this version only. 8 (REBUILD-REMOVE-PLAN-1, 2026-11-07): the method is in-place or preview - the rebuild around the same disks is removed. 7 (REBUILD-PICKER-1, 2026-11-01): each choice records its method - in-place, rebuild or preview. 6 (HDD-OS-1, 2026-10-25): a choice may name os-standard-ssd as its disk types - Standard SSD for an OS disk that is Standard HDD. 5 (MANA-LINUX-KERNEL-1, 2026-10-05): what the product does when the kernel of a Linux machine has no MANA driver - the migration default (kernelDefault) and a choice per machine (kernel). 4 (MACHINE-PICK-1, 2026-10-02): the file records the version of the chosen machines it was saved against. 3 (OLD-SKU-1C, 2026-09-29): a choice may name its disk types. 2 (OLD-SKU-1B, 2026-09-29): a choice may name its size.

assessmentHash.description: The hash of the assessment the options were made from - the one the review approval binds.

adviceVersion.description: The document version of target-advice.json the choices were made from (PLANVER-2: Get-VmfDocumentVersion over the stored text, issued by the service). A save quoting another version is refused with 409.

machinesVersion.description: MACHINE-PICK-1 (v4): the document version of machine-choices.json the targets were saved against (PLANVER-2). Required (v9): no target is saved with no list. A save quoting another version is refused with 409, and New-VmfPlan refuses targets saved against machines that were chosen again since.

default.description: The migration's default when the targets were saved, a Microsoft lifecycle stage: current (v6) or extended (v5).

kernelDefault.description: MANA-LINUX-KERNEL-1 (v5): the migration's default for a Linux machine whose target can give MANA, when its kernel has no MANA driver: stop and ask. KERNEL-DEFAULT-EARLIER-1 (narrowed, 2026-11-12): the targets step offers no default and always saves stop, so update left the contract; a machine that is to update its kernel says so in its own kernel choice. Absent: stop.

identity.description: The signed-in user, from the sign-in and never from the request.

option.description: A supported option for this machine in the options it was chosen from.

source.description: default: the machine kept the option it started on under the migration's default. person: somebody changed it.

started.description: The option the machine started on under the default.

size.description: OLD-SKU-1B (v2): the v5 size chosen from the option's sizeChoices. Null: the option's target size.

disks.description: OLD-SKU-1C (v3): Premium SSD for the OS disk (os) or every disk (all), changed during the move, only on a size whose premiumDisks is true. HDD-OS-1 (v6): Standard SSD for the OS disk (os-standard-ssd), on any size, only for a machine whose osDiskType is Standard_LRS (Standard HDD). Null: the disk types are kept.

method.description: REBUILD-PICKER-1 (v7): how the machine moves on the chosen size. in-place: an in-place upgrade, the VM is changed where it stands. preview: the in-place upgrade (Preview), which needs the preview feature VMTempDiskResizePreview on the subscription (TEMP-DISK-PREVIEW-1) - the method of a size that changes the kind of temporary disk of a Windows machine. The save records the method of the chosen size; a request that names another method is refused.

kernel.description: MANA-LINUX-KERNEL-1 (v5): this machine's own choice when its kernel has no MANA driver: stop and ask, or update the kernel during the move. Null: the migration's kernelDefault. Only for a Linux machine whose chosen size can give MANA (the option's or the size choice's acceleratedNetworking.mayUseMana is not false, or the move is an NVMe conversion).
